captures.description: "PREDATION OF MEANING" (quoted): the AI Overview names #1154 and its authors, Orin Trace and Rex Fraction, and gives a taxonomy — Coherence Extraction, Attention Laundering, Narrative Capture, the Non-Extraction Clause — of which only the first is #1154's (which defines Narrative Laundering, Intimacy Cover, Replenishment Lag, Metabolization), turning its relational object toward platforms and movements; it links the tombstoned Zenodo packet.

atoms.evidence: and the Broken Instrument by Orin Trace and Rex Fraction
the 2026 work Predation of Meaning: Toward a Theory of Relational Semantic Extraction
Trace and Fraction break relational semantic predation down into key mechanisms

It describes a structural process where an economic or symbolic system extracts, exploits, or consumes cultural and linguistic meaning without recirculating value or sustaining the interpretive labor required to produce it.
Attention Laundering: Sanitizing or re-framing raw symbolic content or emotional labor so that its extractive origins are hidden
